n: Digital Promise Maryland library media CS lessons
t: Computer science lessons written by Maryland school library media specialists.
steps: Find the Digital Promise page titled Integrating School Library Media and Computer Science.
Browse the lessons by grade level.
Pick one lesson and read its materials list.
Check what robots or devices it needs.
Ask IT about any software the lesson uses.
Try the lesson with a small group.
Check the live page for lesson titles before planning a unit.
